name: aid-methodology-repo-tooling
description: Node package configuration for tooling used by scripts INSIDE this repository. It lives at the repo root on the owner's rule, and the rule is sharper than a preference: everything under canonical/ is rendered into every adopter's install by design, so a manifest placed there ships whether or not it was meant to. Two manifests previously sat under canonical/aid/scripts/ and both shipped -- the summarize one while its own description said 'Not shipped to adopters'. Deliberately NOT merged into packages/npm/package.json, which is the published `aid-installer` wrapper: dependencies added there reach every npm consumer, and feature-012 D6/G1 requires the vendored bundles to be excluded from both published wrapper manifests. Deliberately carries NO "type" field -- the summarize manifest declared "type": "module" and at the repo root that would make every .js file in the repo ESM; it is safe to drop because both script directories are entirely .mjs, which carries module semantics in the extension.

comments.dependencies: VERSION TRACKING ONLY -- these are never installed from this manifest. The actual bytes live at canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-graph/vendor/<package>/, fetched by hand from each package's own upstream distribution and committed. Dependabot watches this file (.github/dependabot.yml) to notice a new upstream release; it does not and cannot re-vendor the bytes. See canonical/aid/scripts/graph/vendor-provisioning.md for the human follow-on a version bump still requires.
comments.devDependencies: Playwright drives the aid-summarize visual-fidelity gate (validate-visuals.mjs). Run `npm run install-browsers` to fetch the browser after `npm install`. See canonical/aid/scripts/summarize/playwright-provisioning.md.
